behaviour.without_capability: suggest() calls make() (the session factory), passes deadline None to suggest_for, and runs no swap code. The journal lines are the same as at HEAD. TIMXX keeps no match; no finding changes.
behaviour.with_capability_and_port_present: after suggest_for, for each TICKER_NOT_FOUND row with no suggestion member (at most MAX_SUGGESTED_ROWS = 6, one ask per symbol): advisory('swap', symbol, context_symbols=<other file symbols>, deadline=<the upload's deadline>). A refused, failing or non-list answer leaves the finding as it was. A candidates list longer than 3 is refused (SUGGESTIONS_INVALID rule) and the finding is untouched. Candidates whose symbol equals the typo symbol or is not a string are skipped. All remaining proposals go to ONE verify(sorted symbols) read. Kept: exact FOUND (_exact_provider_match). Attached as the finding's suggestions member, at most 3, each {symbol, source: KIMI_SWAP_PROVIDER_VERIFIED, provider_receipt_sha256, reason (plain text, first 200 characters)}.
behaviour.never: No action is added (actions is never touched). No symbol is written into the row. The suggestion member and ACCEPT_SUGGESTION stay the typo lane's alone. A swap lane raise (in suggest_swaps or in building the swap advisory) leaves the check lane's result and never fails the upload.
behaviour.budget: One deadline per upload: suggest() computes deadline = advisory.clock() + TOTAL_SUGGEST_SECONDS and passes it to suggest_for and suggest_swaps. A row the total does not reach counts as unasked for the swap lane and keeps its finding.
behaviour.journal: IRPT_RESIDENT_SWAP asked=N candidates=N verified=N unasked=N (counts only, no symbol). IRPT_RESIDENT_SWAP unavailable when the swap advisory cannot be built.

wire_shape.present_when: only when at least one candidate verified for that finding; absent otherwise, so a finding with no swap result is byte-identical to today.

item.symbol: string, the provider-verified ticker (equal to the candidate id)
item.reason: string, the candidate's own reason, plain text, at most 200 characters; a non-string reason becomes an empty string
